description: This Java class defines a REST API resource for managing Tax Groups within the Apache Fineract framework. It includes endpoints to list all tax groups, retrieve a specific tax group or template, create new tax groups, and update existing ones. It leverages JAX-RS annotations for RESTful endpoints, Swagger annotations for API documentation, and depends on various Fineract services for security, data retrieval, and command processing.

classes.name: TaxGroupApiResource
classes.description: REST resource class providing endpoints for CRUD operations on Tax Groups in Fineract, with Swagger documentation integration.

methods.name: retrieveAllTaxGroups
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all tax groups.

methods.name: retrieveTaxGroup
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a specific tax group by ID, with optional template serialization.

methods.name: retrieveTemplate
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a tax group template.

methods.name: createTaxGroup
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new tax group, serializing input request.

methods.name: updateTaxGroup
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an existing tax group by ID.
